agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies (3: m~15.7, 4: m~10.5) fall toward each other from ~2.7 apart to 0.41 by step 9, reaching speeds ~9.6-9.9. With dt~0.0302 (only 6 substeps) the leapfrog substepping under-resolves this stiff close encounter where acceleration ~ G*m/(r^2+0.3^2)^1.5 is huge and rapidly varying, causing a ~58 energy jump on step 9. Reducing dt to 0.01 removes the violation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
